windows.intermediate_caption:
A person walks down the stairs on the left side of the frame early in the sequence. Simultaneously, another person moves from right to left across the upper level of the building’s entrance area, followed shortly after by a third person walking from left to right along the upper level near the right edge of the frame. On the next segment, someone descends the stairs again on the left, while another ascends the stairs on the right; meanwhile, a third individual crosses the upper level near the building entrance. Two people then walk together across a grassy mid-ground area from right to left, passing behind a small tree. 

Later, within the courtyard, several individuals are observed moving about. Near the building entrance on the upper level, two people interact—first, one in a light-colored shirt walks from left to right, then another in a blue shirt passes from right to left behind them. Further uphill, a trio gathers near a table where one person wears a white shirt with their back turned, flanked by two others seemingly conversing. Red-umbrella-covered tables occupy the foreground without any occupants.  

Subsequently, a person approaches the central building entrance from the right, while another stands nearby momentarily before departing leftward; a brief appearance occurs of yet another figure close to the doorway. Then, three more figures approach the building entrance—one from each direction (left, right, and further left)—all dressed differently, including those in light and dark shirts. Shortly afterward, a person in a light-colored shirt and dark pants enters the building via its glass doors after approaching from the right. Meanwhile, earlier movements include a fleeting presence ascending the staircase on the far-left side during this period. Finally, the entire scene becomes empty except for a momentary glimpse of a person climbing the stairs on the left just prior to the end of the recording. Throughout, the setting includes a paved plaza with shaded seating areas beneath red umbrellas, a contemporary structure featuring expansive glass panels, green slopes rising upward, distant mountain silhouettes against a cloudless sky, and consistent ambient daylight illumination.
